facts.statement: A community event called Pirate's Plunder Party was held on the shores/pier of Seaside, where members could play the Pirate's Plunder minigame and collect gold.
facts.quote: Gather yer crew on the shores of Seaside and party on the pier! Members can try their luck at the Pirate's Plunder minigame.

facts.statement: The U.S. and Latin America session was Thursday July 22nd, 2010 at 3pm Pacific Time on Server 1.
facts.quote: Thursday July 22nd, 2010 3pm Pacific Time (U.S. and Latin America) Server 1

facts.statement: The UK and Europe session was Friday July 23rd, 2010 at 9:00am Pacific Time (4:00pm GMT) on Server 1.
facts.quote: Friday July 23rd 9:00am Pacific Time / 4:00pm GMT (UK and Europe) Server 1

article_summaries.title: Community Event: Pirates Plunder Party!
article_summaries.summary: A SOE community event announcement inviting players to a Pirate's Plunder party on the Seaside pier, with the minigame played as a community event. Two scheduled sessions are listed by region (Server 1), and the article explains how to find community events via the Game Guide calendar. The date is inferred from the relative posting time ('2 days, 2 hours ago') against the 2010-07-24 capture.
